messages:
maya: Heads-up — product asked for a single dashboard showing private/VPC export health + per-tenant telemetry deltas. Need to coordinate agent egress + KMS/audit hooks. Who's available to sync?

samir: I can help. quick Q: do we plan push (agent -> rdm-metrics) or pull (collector pulls from agent)?

maya: Prefer push for offline/on-prem customers so agent can buffer, but product wants the same schema as hosted telemetry.

kendra: Push makes firewall rules easier for customers (single outbound socket). We'll need a clear egress IP list or DNS patterns. Also: mTLS for auth, and envelope encryption with customer KMS keys.

david: On the runtime side, agent can buffer to disk and retry, adds ~20KB metadata per batch. We should expose a small handshake endpoint so customers can pre-authorize connections.

ara: Security notes: KMS usage implies we must not ship plaintext audit logs. Audit hooks need to write to local audit log and a signed envelope to remote. Also need an option to disable remote delivery entirely.

maya: Good. For dashboards we need these metrics from runtime: {"uptime","export_queue_depth","last_success_ts","batch_size_p50/p95","tls_handshake_failures","auth_denied"}. Can infra incrementally expose these?

samir: Yes. We can emit those from the agent via a JSON payload to /v1/exports/telemetry. Example payload:```json
{
  "agent_id":"agent-abc",
  "metrics":{"uptime":86400,"export_queue_depth":12},
  "sig":"<base64sig>"
}
```

kendra: For firewall rules we should give customers an example: allow outbound TCP 443 to metrics.redwood.ai (A record list) OR allow IP range 192.0.2.0/24 for partner regions. Also include health-check port 8443 for handshake if they opt-in.

david: Implementation detail: agent will do a short mTLS handshake using a cert signed by our provisioning CA. For KMS envelopes, agent will call local KMS plugin to wrap the symmetric key. We should document the plugin contract.

ara: Add audit hook requirement: every exported batch must append a signed event to local audit.log with fields: timestamp, batch_id, bytes_sent, recipient, key_id. This log must be rotatable and optionally forwarded to customer SIEM.

ops-bot: deploy: telemetry-agent v0.9.3 staged to canary clusters (sha:aa12f) — includes export endpoint + buffering.

maya: Thanks. Next steps: samir/kendra draft a customer-facing network + handshake guide; david/ara draft agent contract for KMS/audit hooks; I'll wire the dashboard fields with product.

samir: I can sketch the network doc by EOD tomorrow.

kendra: I'll draft the mTLS handshakes and DNS/IP guidance.

david: Will add the KMS plugin interface: exec plugin binary with env var CONTRACT_V1=true; plugin returns JSON with {"wrap_key":"<b64>","key_id":"..."}.

ara: I'll add audit formats and a minimal retention policy suggestion.

maya: Awesome. Can we also add a simple troubleshooting checklist for customers (iptables dump, curl handshake, check audit.log)?

samir: yes:```bash
# quick debug
iptables -L -v -n | grep 443
curl -v --cert client.pem --key client.key https://metrics.redwood.ai/handshake
cat /var/log/redwood/agent/audit.log | tail -n 50
```

kendra: One more: add sample firewall allow for egress via proxy: allow CONNECT to metrics.redwood.ai:443 through corporate proxy; include proxy auth header example.

maya: Perfect. Let's reconvene after drafts. Thanks all :rocket:
